# Paint Selection

Paints a live, geometric selection directly onto surfaces in your scene.

`lfs.paint_selection` · Selection

## How to use

Select the node and turn on Paint, then drag over a surface; hold Alt/Option to erase.  
Use [ and ] to resize the brush. Each stroke remains valid when the element count changes.  

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Softness | `Softness` | lfs.float | 0.5 | min 0; max 1; step 0.01 | Fraction of each sample radius used for the edge fade, 0–1. 0 gives a hard edge; 0.5 is the default. |

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Selection | `Selection` | lfs.float | — | — | Selection strength: 0 is unselected, 1 fully selected; values between them make soft transitions. |

## Settings

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Strokes | `data` | data | [] | — | Surface strokes stored as host-local samples. Painting fills this data; it is empty by default. |
| Invert | `invert` | bool | false | — | Reverse the painted selection. Off by default keeps painted areas; on selects the rest. |
